en: Colored vintage postcard showing a cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story buildings with ornate balconies and large windows. People walk and stand in the street, including a man in the foreground and a person pushing a cart. On the right is an elegant corner building with decorative façade details. The sky has a soft pastel tone. The front of the card is heavily covered with handwritten text in Spanish. Printed red captions at the top identify the scene as an avenue in Ferrol associated with the Naval Headquarters. A handwritten date at the bottom reads "Ferrol 8‑V‑1907".
